Do nootropics drug has the similar effects as steroid on the human body?

No, nootropics (aka "smart drugs") function very differently from steroids. Anabolic steroids, or anabolic-androgenic steroids (AAS), are synthetic derivatives of the naturally produced hormone testosterone. They promote the growth of muscle (anabolic effect) and the typical male characteristics of puberty (androgenic effect). By contrast, nootropics work to improve your memory, alertness, speed, and reduce mental fatigue by altering the levels of certain neurochemicals in the brain.

In other words, steroids cause hormonal changes and result in muscular growth, while nootropics cause neurochemical/neurotransmitter changes and result in improved cognitive performance.
